name: Letros
short_description: Turns textbook photos, PDFs or Word files into interactive language lessons, live classes and homework checks for teachers and schools.
short_description_fr: Transforme une photo de manuel, un PDF ou un fichier Word en leçons de langue interactives, cours en direct et corrections de devoirs, pour profs et écoles.
long_description: Letros is a web platform for language teachers and schools: classes, courses and homework in one place. You can turn a textbook photo, PDF or Word file into interactive exercises and check handwritten essays against Cambridge criteria. Students never pay. Every plan has every feature. Yearly billing is offered at 25% off. Official copy also says any plan is free until 31 December 2026, with no card. The legal name on the site is TOTORO TEACHER DOO BAR (Bar, Montenegro).
features: Textbook photo, PDF or Word to interactive exercises; Handwritten essay check against Cambridge criteria; Classes, courses and homework in one place; Students never pay; Launch offer until 31 December 2026

name: AudioPod AI
short_description: A browser audio workstation for text-to-speech, music, stem splitting, transcription and noise reduction, with a free monthly credit allowance.
short_description_fr: Un studio audio dans le navigateur pour la synthèse vocale, la musique, la séparation de stems, la transcription et le débruitage, avec des crédits gratuits chaque mois.
long_description: AudioPod AI is a browser AI audio workstation for podcasts and audiobooks, covering text-to-speech (200+ languages), music generation, stem separation, transcription, noise reduction and voice cloning. Official pricing: Basic is free, with 1,000 credits every month and no card (~3 minutes of TTS or ~1 minute of music). A 14-day money-back guarantee and commercial use on paid/PAYG credits are stated. The pricing page was marked last updated 13 October 2026 (slightly outside a strict 3-week window; TAAFT listed an initial release on 1 November).
features: Text-to-speech, music, stem splitting, transcription, noise reduction and voice cloning in one studio; 200+ TTS languages; Free monthly credit allowance, no card; Pay-as-you-go credits that never expire; 14-day money-back guarantee

name: AI Floor Plan
short_description: Generates an editable 2D and 3D floor plan from a description of rooms and area, with a free starter credit.
short_description_fr: Génère un plan d’étage éditable en 2D et 3D à partir d’une description des pièces et de la surface, avec un crédit de départ offert.
long_description: AI Floor Plan (aifloorplan.org) turns a description of rooms and total area into an editable floor plan you can adjust, walk through in 3D and export. One AI floor plan uses 20 credits; editing, 3D views and exports never use credits. Official pricing: new accounts start with 20 free credits (one plan). Subscription credits do not roll over. Free PNG/SVG exports include an aifloorplan.org mark; paid plans and credit packs include watermark-free exports during the paid credit period. The site says AI layouts are concepts and you should work with a licensed architect before construction.
features: Text to editable 2D and 3D floor plans; 20 free starter credits; Editing, 3D views and exports use no credits; Cancel any time; Layouts are concepts; the site advises working with a licensed architect before construction

name: Tallbell
short_description: An AI receptionist named Tally that answers calls from your website knowledge, takes messages, and can book jobs on your calendar.
short_description_fr: Une réceptionniste IA, Tally, qui répond aux appels à partir du site, prend les messages et peut réserver des créneaux sur ton calendrier.
long_description: Tallbell is an AI phone receptionist (Tally) that answers calls day and night from your website, takes messages and emails you after each call. Calls under 20 seconds, spam and your own numbers do not count.
features: 24/7 AI phone receptionist (Tally) that answers from your website; Takes messages and emails you after each call; Calendar booking on Book (Google, Outlook, iPhone); Website and simple CRM on Grow; 14-day trial on Answer and Book

name: Nico
short_description: A Mac voice-to-action agent that runs tasks on the AI account you already have; Plus adds spoken replies and better recognition.
short_description_fr: Un agent Mac qui passe de la voix à l’action, en s’appuyant sur le compte IA que tu as déjà ; Plus ajoute les réponses parlées et une meilleure reconnaissance.
long_description: Nico is a macOS voice-to-action personal agent. New accounts get 7 days of Plus with no card. Yearly billing is offered with a stated 20% saving. The site also lists many UI languages.
features: Voice-to-action personal agent on Mac; Uses the AI account you already have; On-device speech recognition on the Free plan; Spoken replies and higher accuracy on Plus; 7 days of Plus free, no card

name: TimeLoop
short_description: A calendar app that can rebuild your day from what you say or type, with a lasting free plan and a Pro subscription.
short_description_fr: Un agenda qui peut replanifier ta journée à partir de ce que tu dis ou tu tapes, avec une offre gratuite durable et un abonnement Pro.
long_description: TimeLoop is a schedule app for iPhone, Android, Mac and the web: the Free plan lets you plan the day by hand, shuffle a late day with a tap, and sync with phone and Google calendars, with no card and no end date (€0/month). TimeLoop Pro adds planning from what you say or type, leaving-time estimates and more. On app.trytimeloop.com the price is in euros, VAT included; other-country store prices are shown before you subscribe. One Pro subscription covers all signed-in devices.
features: Calendar for iPhone, Android, Mac and the web; Lasting free plan, no card; Plan the day by voice or text on Pro; Sync with phone and Google calendars; One subscription across signed-in devices

name: ScholarSail
short_description: An AI study workspace with flashcards, quizzes, mind maps and 3D memory palaces, plus a free tier and an 18 € Premium plan.
short_description_fr: Un espace d’étude IA avec flashcards, quiz, cartes mentales et palais de mémoire 3D, avec une offre gratuite et un plan Premium à 18 €.
long_description: ScholarSail is an AI study tool with flashcards, quizzes, mind maps and walkable 3D memory palaces. TAAFT lists a v3.0 update in this window — this is a version bump of a product not already in the catalogue, so it is flagged as an existing product update.
features: Flashcards, quizzes, mind maps and walkable 3D memory palaces; Free plan with monthly AI credits; Launch promo for the first 3 months of Premium; One-off credit packs that last 12 months

name: TunedGift
short_description: Turns a story into a personalized song gift, with a one-song purchase, a monthly plan or a yearly unlimited plan.
short_description_fr: Transforme une histoire en chanson personnalisée à offrir, en achat d’un morceau, en abonnement mensuel ou en forfait annuel illimité.
long_description: TunedGift creates personalized AI songs as gifts, with AI covers, a private gift link and MP3 downloads.
features: Personalized AI songs as gifts, with a private gift link and MP3 downloads; AI covers; One-song purchase or monthly / yearly plans; Optional wall art and videos on the paid plans

name: TranslateBuff
short_description: A browser extension that translates web pages and selected text, with a free trial and Pro plans billed at clear annual or multi-month totals.
short_description_fr: Une extension de navigateur qui traduit les pages et le texte sélectionné, avec un essai gratuit et des offres Pro dont les totaux de facturation sont affichés clairement.
long_description: TranslateBuff is an AI translation browser extension for full pages and selected text, with side-by-side reading and 20+ models on Pro. The footer names Junyun Limited.
features: Browser extension for full pages and selected text; Side-by-side reading; 20+ models on Pro; Free basic trial

name: TextRemover.video
short_description: Erases on-screen text from a video and restores the background, with signup credits, monthly plans and one-time packs.
short_description_fr: Efface le texte à l’écran d’une vidéo et reconstruit le fond, avec des crédits à l’inscription, des abonnements et des packs ponctuels.
long_description: TextRemover.video removes text from videos and rebuilds the background rather than blurring it. Official pricing: new accounts get 30 free processing seconds on signup (valid 30 days, no card, once per account; up to two new accounts per signup network each month). Credits are one per second of video, with the cost shown before you start. Free and subscription credits are spent before pack credits.
features: Erases on-screen text and restores the background rather than blurring it; 30 free seconds on signup, no card; Monthly plans and one-time packs that do not expire; Failed or unused pack credits stay available

name: Tiquiz
short_description: Builds AI quiz funnels that tag leads and send them to Systeme.io, GoHighLevel or a webhook, with a free plan and clear paid tiers.
short_description_fr: Crée des tunnels de quiz IA qui taguent les leads et les envoient vers Systeme.io, GoHighLevel ou un webhook, avec une offre gratuite et des tarifs clairs.
long_description: Tiquiz is a quiz builder that captures leads and sends the result and tag to Systeme.io, GoHighLevel or any tool by webhook. No card is required to start on Free.
features: AI quiz funnels with lead tagging; Systeme.io, GoHighLevel or webhook connections; Follow-up emails and custom domain on paid plans; Free plan with no card

name: Unmerge
short_description: Splits a flat image into movable layers (up to 17), sold per image, as a credit pack, or on a monthly Pro or Ultra plan.
short_description_fr: Sépare une image plate en calques déplaçables (jusqu’à 17), en paiement à l’image, en pack de crédits, ou en abonnement Pro ou Ultra.
long_description: Unmerge splits a flat image into movable layers (at most 17, background included) and exports a layered PSD, PNG ZIP and composite PNG. Samples are free with no account; a confirmed email gets one free watermarked preview of your own image. Unused subscription credits expire at the end of each month. You need at least 5 credits to start a credit-priced split.
features: Splits a flat image into up to 17 movable layers; Exports layered PSD, PNG ZIP and composite PNG; Free samples and a watermarked preview; Failed splits are not charged

name: FillWise
short_description: A Chrome extension that fills web forms and PDFs from pasted text, a photo, a scan or a file, with a free starting allowance.
short_description_fr: Une extension Chrome qui remplit formulaires web et PDF à partir d’un texte, d’une photo, d’un scan ou d’un fichier, avec un quota gratuit pour commencer.
long_description: FillWise is an AI form filler for web forms and PDFs (fillable and flat). You paste text or drop a passport photo, scan or PDF as the source data. Official pricing: every paid plan has the same features and differs by volume. Free includes 5 fills a week and 20 fills to start, no card. A fill is one web form, or a PDF of up to 5 pages with fields (longer PDFs cost one fill per started 5 pages). An attached photo or PDF used as data is included up to 10 pages, then adds one fill per started 10 pages.
features: Chrome extension that fills web forms and PDFs; Source data from pasted text, a photo, a scan or a file; Works on fillable and flat PDFs; Free starting allowance, no card

name: GenColor AI
short_description: Turns a photo or a text prompt into printable coloring pages, on Basic, Plus and Studio monthly plans.
short_description_fr: Transforme une photo ou un prompt en coloriages imprimables, via les offres mensuelles Basic, Plus et Studio.
long_description: GenColor AI generates printable coloring pages from a photo or a text prompt, with PNG and PDF export. Two variations per generation are included on the listed plans.
features: Photo or text prompt to printable coloring pages; PNG and PDF export; Two variations per generation; Commercial rights on Studio; Limited-time official annual promo

name: Learn to Speak Easy
short_description: Daily impromptu speaking practice with a timer and feedback; one prompt a day is free, and Pro is clearly priced in euros.
short_description_fr: Un entraînement quotidien à l’improvisation orale, avec minuteur et retour ; un prompt par jour est gratuit, et Pro est tarifé clairement en euros.
long_description: Learn to Speak Easy is an impromptu speaking practice app: you get a random prompt, a timed answer, and feedback. Pro adds unlimited prompts and full coaching (structure, what worked, what to work on next, and a transcript). The first 7 days of Pro are free, with no card. Euro prices include VAT. The legal name on the site is Norwich Website Design Ltd.
features: Daily timed impromptu speaking prompts with feedback; Free plan: one prompt a day, no card; Pro adds unlimited prompts, structure coaching and a transcript; 7-day Pro trial, no card

name: Image To Outline
short_description: Converts a photo into a clean outline or line drawing in the browser, officially 100% free, with no watermark and no signup.
short_description_fr: Transforme une photo en contour ou dessin au trait dans le navigateur, officiellement 100 % gratuit, sans filigrane et sans inscription.
long_description: Image To Outline is a browser tool that turns a JPG, PNG or WEBP photo into a line drawing or outline (styles include pencil sketch, coloring page, Chinese ink and others). Official site copy states it is 100% free, with no watermark and no signup. No paid plan is listed on the official homepage checked.
features: Photo to outline or line art in the browser; Multiple styles including pencil, coloring page and ink; 100% free, no watermark, no signup

name: Boba
short_description: A goals and planning assistant you text or use on the web, in one-to-one or group chats, officially free with no card and no app install.
short_description_fr: Un assistant pour tes objectifs et tes plans, par SMS ou sur le web, en tête-à-tête ou en groupe, officiellement gratuit, sans carte et sans application à installer.
long_description: Boba is an AI assistant for goals, habits, plans and group coordination. You text it from your phone, add it to a group chat, or use it on the web. Nothing to download; it works in Messages and on the web. There is no /pricing path. A paid plan was not listed on the official homepage checked. The site notes that Boba can get things wrong, and that messages may be used to improve it.
features: Goals and planning assistant by text or on the web; Works in one-to-one or group chats; Officially free, no card, no app install

name: Whisper Web
short_description: Runs Whisper speech recognition in the browser, privately on your device, and is officially completely free, with no signup or upload required.
short_description_fr: Fait tourner la reconnaissance vocale Whisper dans le navigateur, en local sur l’appareil, et se présente officiellement comme entièrement gratuite, sans inscription ni envoi de fichier.
long_description: Whisper Web is a browser speech-recognition and transcription tool (including MP4 and M4A) that can run privately on your device with no upload. Official site copy: “Completely free to use” and “Free AI speech recognition, privately on your device — no uploads.” A /pricing path returns 404, and no paid plan is listed on the official homepage checked. A text-to-speech mode is also linked from the site.
features: In-browser Whisper transcription; Local/private mode with no upload; No signup; Officially completely free; Video and audio file support

name: Gleeday
short_description: An AI event planner for invitations, RSVPs and reminders, with an official pricing page that states there is no premium tier and no hidden fees.
short_description_fr: Un planificateur d’événements IA pour invitations, RSVP et rappels, dont la page tarifaire officielle indique qu’il n’y a ni offre premium ni frais cachés.
long_description: Gleeday is an AI event planner for digital invitations, unlimited guests, RSVP tracking, reminders and planning suggestions. No hidden fees.” The FAQ states it is completely free, with no asterisk, no catch, and no free trial that becomes a subscription — every feature, guest and event, free forever.
features: AI invitations, unlimited guests, RSVP tracking and reminders; Officially free, no ads and no premium tier; Planning suggestions

name: College Essay Grader
short_description: Grades college application essays with scores, line notes and a revision plan; the first essay is free, then Pro is 36 € and Unlimited is 54 € a month.
short_description_fr: Évalue les essais d’admission à l’université, avec notes, commentaires en marge et plan de révision ; le premier essai est gratuit, puis Pro est à 36 € et Unlimited à 54 € par mois.
long_description: College Essay Grader (collegeessaygrader.ai) reviews Common App, UC, Coalition, UCAS and supplemental essays with a six-part score, margin notes and a revision plan. You can cancel anytime. A differently priced product exists at collegeessaygrader.com and is not this row.
features: Scores, line notes and a revision plan for college application essays; Supports Common App, UC, Coalition, UCAS and supplementals; First essay free forever; Cancel anytime

name: Typeless
short_description: Turns messy spoken thoughts into clear writing in any app; Free is 0 €, and Pro is 11 € per member per month billed yearly or 27 € billed monthly.
short_description_fr: Transforme tes idées dictées en texte clair dans n’importe quelle appli ; l’offre Free est gratuite, et Pro est à 11 € par membre et par mois en facturation annuelle, ou 27 € en mensuel.
long_description: Typeless is a voice dictation product for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android that turns messy thoughts into clear writing in any app, with translation and a personal dictionary. Enterprise is custom. TAAFT listed Typeless in this window; the product may already have been on the market before that listing, so it is flagged as possibly older than a first launch.
features: Voice dictation to cleaned-up writing in any app; Translation and a personal dictionary; 100+ languages; Free plan and a Pro plan per member; Enterprise custom

name: YoFont
short_description: Generates installable fonts (TTF, OTF, WOFF) from a sentence, with a free 100-glyph plan and paid Starter, Pro and Studio tiers.
short_description_fr: Crée des polices installables (TTF, OTF, WOFF) à partir d’une phrase, avec 100 glyphes offerts et des offres payantes Starter, Pro et Studio.
long_description: YoFont generates multi-script typefaces (60 languages, 9 writing systems) from a text prompt, with a glyph editor and TTF/OTF/WOFF/WOFF2 export. Annual billing is offered at 20% off. 1 glyph equals 1 drawn character.
features: Prompt-to-installable multi-script fonts (TTF, OTF, WOFF); 60 languages and 9 writing systems; Glyph editor; Studio adds commercial use, private fonts and API/MCP

name: Figlet
short_description: An AI relationship coach built by a practising therapist, with free first messages and two clearly priced subscriptions.
short_description_fr: Un coach relationnel IA conçu par un thérapeute en exercice, avec les premiers messages offerts et deux abonnements clairement tarifés.
long_description: Figlet (Figlet by Empathi) is AI relationship coaching software grounded in Emotionally Focused Therapy, built by Figs O’Sullivan, LMFT. The site states it is coaching, not therapy, and is not related to the FIGlet ASCII banner tool. Official subscribe page: first messages are free, no credit card required to start. You can cancel anytime. A “Team Us” figure mentioned elsewhere on the marketing site was not used, because it was not part of this complete subscribe ladder.
features: EFT-grounded relationship coaching (the site states it is coaching, not therapy); Built by a practising therapist; First messages free, no card; Cancel anytime

name: AI Portfolio Analyst
short_description: Analyses a stock portfolio with buy/hold/sell-style scores, risk and news, from a free Silver plan up to paid Gold, Platinum and Diamond tiers.
short_description_fr: Analyse un portefeuille d’actions avec des scores, le risque et l’actualité, depuis une offre Silver gratuite jusqu’aux offres Gold, Platinum et Diamond.
long_description: AI Portfolio Analyst is a web and mobile stock-portfolio tool: you upload holdings, and it analyses fundamentals, technicals and news. A separate /pricing path was not published (it redirected or 404’d); these amounts are from the official homepage offer markup.
features: Stock portfolio analysis with fundamentals, technicals and news; Buy/hold/sell-style scores and risk assessment; Virtual portfolios on paid plans; Free Silver plan

name: RapVid
short_description: Turns photos into short AI rap videos, with a free first clip, one-time credit packs from 5 € and monthly plans from 12 €.
short_description_fr: Transforme des photos en courtes vidéos rap IA, avec un premier clip offert, des packs de crédits dès 5 € et des abonnements dès 12 € par mois.
long_description: RapVid generates solo, duo or battle-style AI rap videos from photos. A standard 12-second 720p video is 25 credits; failed renders are refunded. Official pricing: the first 5-second clip is free (480p with a RapVid watermark, one per account).
features: Photo-to-rap-video in solo, duo or battle styles; First clip free; One-time packs that never expire, plus monthly plans; Failed renders refunded

name: AnyImg
short_description: Edits or creates images with a prompt across listed models, on two official monthly credit plans: Starter 9 € and Pro 27 €.
short_description_fr: Modifie ou crée des images à partir d’un prompt, sur les modèles proposés, via deux offres mensuelles officielles : Starter à 9 € et Pro à 27 €.
long_description: AnyImg is a web image tool for text-to-image and image-to-image across the models listed on its pricing page. Official pricing: two monthly plans. Credits are valid for 1 month. Downloads and a commercial license are included. Higher-resolution and advanced models may use more credits. Failed generation tasks automatically return consumed credits.
features: Text-to-image and image-to-image across listed models; Commercial license included; Failed jobs refund credits

name: FoziScribe
short_description: Puts script, voice, music, subtitles, dubbing and YouTube growth tools in one subscription, starting with 10 free credits and plans from 4 € a month.
short_description_fr: Réunit script, voix, musique, sous-titres, doublage et outils de croissance YouTube dans un seul abonnement, avec 10 crédits offerts et des offres dès 4 € par mois.
long_description: FoziScribe (with FoziQ) is a YouTuber toolkit: 14 creation tools (script, voiceover, music, sound effects, thumbnails, subtitles, dubbing and more) and 13 growth tools, in one plan. Official pricing: start free with 10 credits, no card. Yearly billing is a stated 25% saving on Creator, Growth and Scale. You can cancel anytime.
features: 14 creation tools and 13 growth tools for YouTubers in one plan; Script, voice, music, subtitles, dubbing and more; 10 free credits, no card; Cancel anytime

name: WinnerAdSpy
short_description: An ad-spy subscription with one official Pro plan at €7 a month or €56 a year.
short_description_fr: Un outil d’ad spy avec une seule offre Pro officielle, à 7 € par mois ou 56 € par an.
long_description: WinnerAdSpy (Winneradspy) is an ad-spy product with unlimited ad-spy access on its Pro plan. Official pricing and FAQ: Pro is €7 per month, billed monthly, cancel anytime, no contract. A yearly plan is €56 per year (33% less than month-to-month, stated as €4.67/month billed yearly). Access lasts until the end of the period you paid for, and future updates are included on the yearly plan. No other public paid tier was listed on the official pricing page checked.
features: Ad-spy access on a single official Pro plan; Monthly or yearly billing; Cancel anytime; Official prices in euros

name: Kawung
short_description: Indonesian business and investment legal research with cited regulations, officially free, with published daily and weekly usage caps.
short_description_fr: Un outil de recherche en droit des affaires et de l’investissement indonésien, avec citations des textes, officiellement gratuit, et des plafonds d’usage publiés.
long_description: Kawung (kawung.id) is a legal-research tool for Indonesian business and investment law: you ask a question and get an explanation with article citations, or you search and read curated regulations (updated weekly, including selected regional rules). Official usage page (Batas pemakaian): it is free (gratis). Each visitor has daily and weekly allowances so everyone can use it — quick research 5/day and 30/week, in-depth research 5/day and 30/week, regulation search 100/day, documents opened 50/day, browse/tool pages 600/day. Daily caps reset at 00:00 WIB; weekly caps reset each Monday at 00:00 WIB. No paid plan is listed on the official pages checked. The interface is available in Indonesian and English.
features: Indonesian business and investment legal research with cited regulations; Officially free with published usage caps; Weekly regulation updates; Indonesian and English interface

name: AISongsMaker
short_description: Generates songs from an idea or lyrics, with a free 30-credit start and Starter, Creator and Studio plans that show both monthly and yearly prices.
short_description_fr: Génère des chansons à partir d’une idée ou de paroles, avec 30 crédits offerts et des offres Starter, Creator et Studio dont les prix mensuels et annuels sont affichés.
long_description: AISongsMaker is an AI music generator with covers, stems, extend/replace tools and MP3/WAV export. The page also advertises a TAAFT-linked Black Friday promo; only the standard official plan prices above are recorded here.
features: Songs from an idea or lyrics, plus covers and stems; MP3/WAV export; Free 30-credit start; Commercial use on Creator and Studio

name: Senpi
short_description: Turns a described trading strategy into a Hyperliquid agent, with a free trial and official Pro, Advanced and Quant plans at 45 €, 89 € and 178 € a month.
short_description_fr: Transforme une stratégie de trading décrite en agent Hyperliquid, avec un essai gratuit et des offres officielles Pro, Advanced et Quant à 45 €, 89 € et 178 € par mois.
long_description: Senpi (Senpi AI Inc., Austin, Texas) is an AI trading-agent product: it turns a described strategy into software that can run on Hyperliquid. Paid plans have 0% Senpi trading fees and access to all models. You can connect Claude, ChatGPT and more on the paid plans.
features: Turns a described strategy into a Hyperliquid trading agent; Free trial with one-time credits; 0% Senpi trading fees on paid plans; Official HQ in Austin, United States

name: ScoreStory
short_description: Combines customer-satisfaction scores with AI follow-up conversations, with a free trial and Essential, Plus and Pro plans in euros.
short_description_fr: Associe des scores de satisfaction à des conversations de suivi IA, avec un essai gratuit et des offres Essential, Plus et Pro en euros.
long_description: ScoreStory combines CSAT/NPS-style scores with AI conversations to explain why a score was given. Official pricing (excluding VAT): Free is 10 participants, no credit card, and you can cancel at no cost if you have not yet had 10 participants. Pro is €475/month or €4,750/year (250/month, 3,000/year, €2.40 extra). An annual contract is pay for 10 months and get 12. Struck-through list yearly figures (€600 / €1,500 / €5,700) also appear next to the current prices. Unlimited users are included; SSO is extra; Enterprise is on request.
features: Combines satisfaction scores with AI follow-up conversations; Free 10-participant start, no card; Official euro prices, excluding VAT; Annual billing: 10 months paid for 12

name: Face Shape Haircut AI

short_description_fr: Mesure gratuitement la forme de ton visage, puis débloque des coupes sur ta photo et une fiche barbier, en achats uniques Basic, Plus ou Pro.

features: Free face-shape measurement from a selfie; Haircuts shown on your photo, with a barber card; Pay once, no subscription; 7-day money-back

short_description_fr: Un coéquipier marketing IA qui analyse tes campagnes payantes, crée annonces et landing pages, lance et optimise les campagnes sur Google, Meta, TikTok et LinkedIn, avec ta validation.
features: Works in Slack, with changes proposed for approval; Dashboards, analysis, creative generation, landing pages and ad-platform automation; Incrementality tests and marketing-mix model add-ons; 30-day trial with full Pro access

features: Behavioural QA agents that use your web product like customers do; Tests written in plain English; Recorded journeys and reproduction steps for each failure; Runs in parallel; First 10 completed runs free per workspace

name: Stiro
short_description: An in-app AI onboarding and customer-success agent for SaaS: users ask in plain words and it clicks, types and navigates your real interface for them, leaving the final click to the user.
short_description_fr: Un agent IA d’onboarding et de customer success intégré à ton SaaS : l’utilisateur demande en langage naturel et Stiro clique, saisit et navigue dans ta vraie interface, en lui laissant le dernier clic.
features: In-app onboarding and customer-success agent for SaaS; One script tag, nothing to train or record; Leaves the final click to the user on actions that send, spend or delete; Escalates stuck requests to your team; Pay per completed task; failed runs free

name: ScroogeFrog AI
short_description: AI ad-fraud detection: audits your traffic and Google Ads, flags bots and fake clicks with custom-trained models, and tells you which campaigns or keywords to pause.
short_description_fr: Détection de fraude publicitaire par IA : audite ton trafic et Google Ads, repère bots et faux clics grâce à des modèles entraînés sur tes données et indique quelles campagnes ou mots-clés couper.
features: Traffic and Google Ads audit; Custom ML models per site; AI recommendations on which campaigns or keywords to pause; Google Ads refund-letter support; 14-day trial on every plan

name: Kino
short_description: An AI video editor for teams and agents: store, search and edit footage on a shared timeline, let Claude or Codex edit via MCP, and collect review notes in one place.
short_description_fr: Un éditeur vidéo IA pour les équipes et les agents : stocke, recherche et monte tes rushes sur une timeline partagée, laisse Claude ou Codex monter via MCP et centralise les retours.
features: Footage indexing and search; Built-in AI chat and a real-time collaborative timeline; MCP server for your own agents (Claude, Codex); Cloud 720p proxies; Free plan with weekly MCP calls

name: Artie
short_description: A team of AI employees (engineer, recruiter, marketer, designer, chief of staff) that take ongoing work across your apps and collaborate through chat, voice and video.
short_description_fr: Une équipe d’employés IA (ingénieur, recruteur, marketeur, designer, chief of staff) qui prennent en charge le travail récurrent dans tes outils et collaborent par chat, voix et vidéo.
features: Role-based AI employees (engineer, recruiter, marketer, designer, chief of staff); Works across your company’s apps; One shared credit balance; Chat, voice and video collaboration

name: IvyCraft
short_description: An AI workspace that turns papers and other sources into slides, infographics, podcasts, comics and videos grounded in your material.
short_description_fr: Un espace de travail IA qui transforme articles et autres sources en slides, infographies, podcasts, BD et vidéos fidèles à tes documents.
features: Grounded generation from uploaded sources; Slides, infographics, podcasts, comics and videos; Agent and workflow loops; Free bonus credits for 30 days, with watermarked exports

name: Clip-Short
short_description: Makes short videos with AI: an idea becomes a narrated, captioned video, and a long video becomes clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.
short_description_fr: Crée des vidéos courtes avec l’IA : une idée devient une vidéo narrée et sous-titrée, et une vidéo longue devient des clips pour TikTok, Reels et Shorts.
features: AI videos from an idea, plus clipping of long videos; Auto captions and reframing for TikTok, Reels and Shorts; No watermark on paid plans; Failed renders not charged; 1 hour of free clipping per month

name: Klipa AI
short_description: A browser video toolkit that turns long videos into vertical clips with animated subtitles, silence and filler removal, dubbing and AI-written scripts.
short_description_fr: Une boîte à outils vidéo en ligne qui transforme les vidéos longues en clips verticaux avec sous-titres animés, suppression des silences et hésitations, doublage et scripts écrits par IA.
features: Turns long videos into vertical clips; Animated subtitles, silence and filler removal; Dubbing in 32 languages and AI-written scripts; Klipa Studio editor; Trial credits with a logo on the output

name: Raylight
short_description: A 3D motion-design canvas for launch videos and product demos that you can edit yourself or let Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor edit on the same canvas.
short_description_fr: Un canevas de motion design 3D pour vidéos de lancement et démos produit, à éditer toi-même ou à confier à Claude, ChatGPT ou Cursor sur le même canevas.
features: 3D motion-design canvas for launch videos and product demos; Edit yourself or let Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor edit the same canvas; Music, SFX and voiceover; MCP server, API and Capture for Mac; Template marketplace

name: Text to GIF
short_description: Creates animated GIFs, stickers and SVGs from a text prompt or an image, with credit packs instead of a subscription.
short_description_fr: Crée des GIF animés, stickers et SVG à partir d’un texte ou d’une image, avec des packs de crédits plutôt qu’un abonnement.
features: Text to GIF, image to GIF, sticker studio and text to SVG; Quality and resolution options; Live quote before generating; Automatic refund on failed generations; Credits never expire, no subscription

name: Kleos
short_description: An AI marketing team for small businesses that plans, writes and publishes posts, articles and newsletters in your voice and tracks how ChatGPT and Google recommend you.
short_description_fr: Une équipe marketing IA pour petites entreprises qui planifie, rédige et publie posts, articles et newsletters avec ton ton, et suit comment ChatGPT et Google te recommandent.
features: Monthly content plan for small businesses; Social posts, articles, newsletters and short videos; Tracks how ChatGPT and Google recommend you; Brand signals and competitor content gaps; Lifetime licence option

name: Epivoke
short_description: Turns a topic or script into a long-form, narrated and animated documentary-style YouTube video ready to upload.
short_description_fr: Transforme un sujet ou un script en longue vidéo YouTube de type documentaire, narrée et animée, prête à publier.
features: Long-form narrated and animated documentary-style YouTube videos (8–60 min); Script writing and review, with 20 free rewrites per video; Visuals chosen line by line from licensed stock and archives; Animated maps, timelines and charts; Failed videos refunded

name: Shot.video
short_description: Turns your laptop and phones into a multi-camera studio: record once, every angle is synced, and AI makes the first edit with cuts, zooms and B-roll suggestions.
short_description_fr: Transforme ton ordinateur et tes téléphones en studio multicaméra : un seul enregistrement, tous les angles synchronisés, et l’IA réalise un premier montage avec coupes, zooms et B-roll.
features: Turns your laptop and phones into a synced multi-camera studio; Phones join by QR code, no app; AI angle cutting, auto zoom and pan, B-roll suggestions; Manual edits are free; Free starter credits

name: Programmable
short_description: Describe who you sell to and an agent finds matching companies, researches each one, finds the right person with a checked email and asks before sending to your outreach tool.
short_description_fr: Décris ta cible et un agent trouve les entreprises correspondantes, les analyse, identifie la bonne personne avec un email vérifié et te demande validation avant l’envoi vers ton outil de prospection.
features: Company discovery with a reason to reach out; Per-company research and verified emails; Approval before export; Zapier, n8n, Make and Google Sheets recipes; Failed rows refunded

name: Spectry
short_description: A privacy-first, EU-hosted analytics platform that shows why visitors don’t convert, with heatmaps, session replays, AI insights and A/B tests to try the fix.
short_description_fr: Une plateforme d’analytics respectueuse de la vie privée, hébergée dans l’UE, qui montre pourquoi les visiteurs ne convertissent pas : heatmaps, replays, insights IA et tests A/B pour valider la correction.
features: Privacy-first, EU-hosted analytics (Google Cloud europe-west4); Heatmaps, session replays, funnels, surveys and feedback widgets; A/B tests and feature flags; AI insights and Ask AI; MCP server and API

name: Sitelas
short_description: A website builder for AI agents: describe your site to Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent and it designs, publishes and runs pages, forms and SEO.
short_description_fr: Un créateur de sites pensé pour les agents IA : décris ton site à Claude, ChatGPT ou ton agent, qui le conçoit, le publie et le gère (pages, formulaires, SEO).
features: Website builder designed for AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code); Full visual builder, forms and collections; Analytics; Custom domain and SSL on Pro; Free live site on a subdomain

name: Marcora
short_description: A context layer for go-to-market teams: positioning, brand voice and product facts in one source of truth that your AI tools read from.
short_description_fr: Une couche de contexte pour les équipes go-to-market : positionnement, ton de marque et infos produit réunis dans une source unique que tes outils IA consultent.
features: Central go-to-market knowledge base; Brand voice and product facts for your AI tools; Studio credits for content; Shareable links with view tracking; Privacy controls on higher plans

name: varg
short_description: An AI video platform and agent that takes a brief to a finished ad, picking the best pipeline for video, image, lipsync, music, speech and captions, also usable from Claude Code, Cursor or ChatGPT.
short_description_fr: Une plateforme et un agent vidéo IA qui transforment un brief en publicité finie, en choisissant le meilleur pipeline (vidéo, image, lipsync, musique, voix, sous-titres), utilisable aussi depuis Claude Code, Cursor ou ChatGPT.
features: AI video platform and agent from brief to finished ad; Picks a pipeline for video, image, lipsync, music, speech and captions; Usable from Claude Code, Cursor or ChatGPT via MCP; API and SDK, templates and canvas; Bulk generation

name: DistributeMusic.AI
short_description: Distributes music made with Suno, Udio, ElevenLabs or any AI engine to Spotify, Apple Music, TikTok and 150+ stores, with automatic AI disclosure.
short_description_fr: Distribue la musique créée avec Suno, Udio, ElevenLabs ou tout moteur IA vers Spotify, Apple Music, TikTok et plus de 150 plateformes, avec déclaration IA automatique.
features: Distributes AI-made music to 150+ stores including Spotify, Apple Music and TikTok; Automatic AI disclosure, free ISRC and UPC; Built-in AI song generator on Pro; Pre-saves; label name, EPs and albums on Label; Distribution API

name: Marsell
short_description: An AI marketing and sales team: give it a link to your business and it plans the month, makes posts, ads and short films, publishes everywhere, answers comments and finds buyers.
short_description_fr: Une équipe marketing et commerciale IA : donne le lien de ton activité, elle planifie le mois, crée posts, pubs et petits films, publie partout, répond aux commentaires et trouve des acheteurs.
features: Monthly content planning from a link to your business; Posts, ads and short films, with multi-channel publishing; Comment replies and buyer finding; MCP Registry listing; Free first look, no card
